target: Any material public FDA 510(k) or original/panel-track PMA activity for an already-active company-track pair during the next 12 months
holdout: last chronological origin; excluded from model and feature selection
split: expanding-window rolling-origin, no random temporal split

ablations.rd_financial: R&D features plus eleven consolidated SEC Company Facts features

excluded_from_historical_gain.procurement: USAspending current snapshot cannot reconstruct first-publication time

metrics: mean lead time among positive targets
notes: This is a public-milestone proxy model, not a measurement of internal R&D start dates or a causal claim.
